name: Pasatiempo (Santa Cruz hills: Monterey pine and cypress, oaks, white sand, golden barrancas)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2 for the rough). Pasatiempo Golf Club, Santa Cruz CA, in the hills ~4 km above Monterey Bay: firm, warm, slightly yellow-green summer fairways; newly rebuilt bentgrass greens (G8-G9); a mid-olive rough; MacKenzie's flashed bunkers in bright near-white sand (S0-S2, whiter than the peninsula's cream); dark pine and cypress duff under the trees (G0-G2); and off the course the golden-tan summer grass of the barranca banks and hillsides (L0-L2, the out-of-bounds ground); a shaded, dark creek. From published descriptions (the scouting's theme notes: 'glistening white sand', cypress-lined fairways, summer-dry hills) and NAIP; no club imagery used. Trees in assets-src/trees_pasatiempo.py: Monterey pine, coast redwood and eucalyptus; coast live oak and Monterey cypress. Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
